fields.name: Id
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BC2C70 (loader, only user of 'ls.thoth.client.condition') fills +0x00..0x10 with two results of the random generator FUN_144130d80 - a freshly generated Guid; this Guid is the key of CompiledConditions (bg3.exe+0x1A5AE70 passes the record pointer as key to FUN_140ef16d0).

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BC2C70: default 5, then set to the value 0..5 mapped from the source record's type field; the same byte is used as the key of the Conditions map (FUN_141bc3850(map, &type)).

fields.name: field_14
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BC2C70: default -1, then CreateFromString from a std::string of the source record (source +0x30); destructor bg3.exe+0x18898A0 DecRefs it. Which name it is (event / condition name) not established.

fields.name: Condition
fields.evidence: 24-byte small-string (buffer 0x18, size 0x28, capacity 0x2C, default capacity 15; freed when capacity > 15 in bg3.exe+0x18898A0). bg3.exe+0x1A5AE70 / 0x1A5B010 copy it, append a 4-char suffix and hand it to FUN_141a5b220 (only user of the string 'conditions') and then to the Thoth compiler FUN_140effd00 - the condition source text.

fields.name: field_30
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BC2C70: default -1, copied from the source record (source +0x48).

fields.name: field_34
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BC2C70: default 0, set to 1 together with field_30 - looks like the 'has value' byte of std::optional<int32_t> {field_30, field_34}.

fields.name: field_38
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BC2C70: 16 bytes copied from the source record (source +0x18..0x28), default 0.

fields.name: field_48
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BC2C70: default 0, 4 bytes copied from source +0x28.

fields.name: field_50
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BC2C70: 16 bytes copied from the first 16 bytes of the source record (its own id), default 0.

fields.name: field_60
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1BC2C70: default -1, CreateFromString from the last std::string of the source record; DecRef in destructor bg3.exe+0x18898A0.

fields.name: _Pad64
fields.evidence: tail padding; element stride 0x68 in bg3.exe+0x1889570 (array grow) and in the loops of bg3.exe+0x1A5AE70

fields.name: Timeline
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1D78C60: ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(storage, 0x58, ...), copies the four dwords of the Guid argument into +0..+0xF, zeroes +0x10..+0x4F (the map) and writes a zero byte at +0x50. caller bg3.exe+0x1D59100 (ecl::TimelineSystem, combat/arena timeline finished loading) passes the timeline Guid it also stores at +0x100 of ecl::CombatTimelineDataComponent. bg3.exe+0x1A56E10 passes these 16 bytes as the Guid looked up in the arena triggers' HashSet<Guid>.

fields.name: Events
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes a 64-byte hash map at +0x10. bg3.exe+0x1D59100 walks the timeline's 0x20-byte records (+0x350, count +0x35C of the timeline content): lookup/insert by the record's type byte (+0x10; 1-byte key compare, bg3.exe+0x1BC3850 - the same helper as GlobalThothComponent::Conditions), then appends a 0x68-byte element (grow helper bg3.exe+0x1889570, the one used for TimelineThothCondition): fresh random Guid, type byte, FixedString +0x14, STDString built from the record's FixedString +0x1C, int32 +0x30 from record +0x18, bool +0x34 = 0, Guid +0x38 = the timeline Guid, int32 +0x48 = record index, Guid +0x50 = 0, FixedString +0x60 = -1. bg3.exe+0x1A5FE20 (ecl::timeline::ActiveEventSystem) iterates the values with stride 0x10 and the arrays with stride 0x68.

fields.name: field_50
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0; bg3.exe+0x1D59100 copies byte +0xFD of ecl::CombatTimelineDataComponent (itself copied from byte 9 of the creation request).

open_questions: TimelineThothCondition is declared identically (same members, offsets, types) in the confirmed layout ecl.timeline.GlobalThothComponent.json; its unnamed members must stay named the same in both files. Learned here: field_14 = event name (key of GlobalEventFrequencyComponent::Cooldowns), field_38 = Guid of the owning timeline, field_48 = index of the record in the timeline.
field_50: a flag of the combat-timeline creation request; meaning not established.
second_pass: Settled on Windows: the creator bg3.exe+0x1D78C60 allocates 0x58 bytes (Guid at +0, 64-byte map at +0x10, byte at +0x50) and bg3.exe+0x1D59100 fills the map with a 1-byte key and 0x68-stride arrays; the element struct is the same shape as in the live-confirmed GlobalThothComponent layout.
